jobs.name: empty-cart
jobs.prompt: Ultra-wide banner photo of a stylish, dimly lit sports locker room: an empty wooden bench runs across the frame, on it a neatly folded plain white football shirt with no print at all, a football and a basketball resting side by side, a pair of boots on the floor underneath. One warm spotlight falls on the bench from above; the back wall of dark lockers catches a soft acid-lime (#C6FF3D) accent glow. The objects sit in the centre of the frame; the left and right thirds are calm dark lockers. Quiet, inviting, waiting-for-the-game mood.
